title: DAG Shortest Paths with Negative Edges

constraints.is_dag: The graph is guaranteed to be a DAG.

input_format: The first line contains n, m, and src. Each of the next m lines contains u, v, and w describing a directed edge u -> v with weight w.
output_format: Print n lines. For each vertex i, print the shortest distance from src to i if it is reachable; otherwise print UNREACHABLE.
notes: The graph is acyclic but may contain negative edge weights.
This task invalidates ordinary Dijkstra and expects a topological relaxation approach.
UNREACHABLE is used instead of a numeric sentinel because a reachable shortest distance can legally be -2 under the constraints.
